name: video-prompt-director
description: Create five detailed video prompt variations by default, with scene-by-scene direction, timed action, reference roles, and continuity controls.

interface.longDescription: Develop five complete video concepts by default, each with detailed scene and shot direction, timed action, camera choreography, continuity, sound, and copy-ready clip prompts. Covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference media, first/last frames, narrative endpoints, keyframes, continuation, edits, loops, and longer sequences. Includes dated Grok and Google Omni guidance and a portable workflow for other models. Respects requested counts, duration, brevity, and single-shot requirements. Authors prompts and production plans; rendering and assembly use your chosen tools separately.
defaultPrompt: Create five detailed scene-by-scene video prompt variations from my brief, with copy-ready shot prompts.
Plan five video variations between my first and last frames, preserving identity and plausible motion.
Turn my reference images into five cinematic video prompt variations for Grok video or Google Omni.
